description: MP govt launches AI and FinTech courses in 68 colleges with IIT Delhi to boost youth skills, digital learning, and job opportunities.
body_lead: Bhopal: In a major step to empower youth and strengthen the state’s digital economy, the Madhya Pradesh government, led by Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, has announced the launch of AI (Artificial Intelligence) and FinTech certificate courses in 68 government colleges across the state from the academic session 2026-27. This initiative aims to equip students with technical skills and practical knowledge to thrive in emerging industries. Government’s Youth-Friendly Initiative The BJP-led Mohan Yadav government has been taking several measures to accelerate development in the state.
